title: K211591: NAEOTOM Alpha, Scan&GO, 510(k) summary and clearance letter
version: 510(k) K211591 determination letter dated 30 September 2021 and applicant technical summary.
lineage: The regulator confirms clearance. The manufacturer states the engineering relationship in the accompanying submission; it is not an inference from the predicate field.

passages.note: Describes the Force as predicate and design base for Alpha's dual-source scanner configuration. The two ceramic energy-integrating detectors give way to two CdTe photon-counting detectors.
passages.quote: building on the dual-source CT system configuration of the primary predicate device SOMATOM Force
